authors: Erin Rae Toppe; prepared with Claude
claim: The opener -> middle -> closer layout holds at every major Indus site even when the sign roles are learned without that site: for each test site, roles learned from all other sites put the site's texts in slot order more often than within-text shuffling.
site_rule: home sites with 20+ complete deduplicated texts (export all splits + held-out-from-export set); only counts per site were looked at
role_rule: scripts/functional_skeleton.py RULE (min 15 uses; opener starts >=40% and >=1.8x shuffle; closer ends >=50% and >=1.8x; numerals by shape; other signs with 15+ uses middle)
statistic: hypotheses kind template_order per site; primary: Stouffer combination of per-site one-sided p; secondary: number of sites with p < 0.05
basis: H-2026-10-15-0c595386 (Mohenjo-daro roles transfer to other sites, supported) and its new-set replication (p 0.0005). This extends it so that every major site is a test site.
note: Uses texts from the locked holdout and the held-out-from-export set as test data for this new question. Registered before running.
